title: Artin-Schreier curves of prescribed p-rank without extra automorphisms
summary: Let p be an odd prime. We study the Artin-Schreier analogue of Poonen's problem of constructing curves without extra automorphisms. An Artin-Schreier curve carries an unavoidable deck group Cp, so the smallest possible full geometric automorphism group inside the Artin-Schreier locus is Cp. We determine the exact numerical range in which this minimum is attained, for every p-rank. More precisely, for integers r >= 0 and N >= 1, there exists an Artin-Schreier curve X/Fp with g(X) = (p - 1)N/2, gamma(X) = r(p - 1), Aut_Fp(X) is isomorphic to Cp if and only if either r = 0, p does not divide N…
